children: If the yen continues to strengthen, certain Asian currencies could benefit from spillovers, MUFG's Michael Wan says in a note. The analyst reckons that the South Korea won, and to a smaller extent the Thai baht, Singapore dollar and Philippines peso, in that order, are more sensitive to yen moves. Among other Asian currencies, the Indian rupee has outperformed recently, driven by much-higher-than-expected dollar inflows from the RBI's special forex swap facility. Still, Wan thinks the dollar-rupee pair will trend higher over time, though the Indian central bank has "meaningful firepower and ammunition" to prevent the currency from a sharp depreciation. (sherry.qin@wsj.com)
